text: The contractor shall furnish all labor, tools, materials, equipment, and transportation to de-install, remove, transport, and dispose of two GE INNOVA 4100-IQ imaging systems and peripherals.

citations.quote: The contractor shall furnish all labor, tools, materials, equipment, and transportation necessary to fully de-install, remove, transport, and dispose of two (2) GE INNOVA 4100-IQ imaging systems and associated peripheral subcomponents from Radiology (1D44/1D42A in building 1) at the George E Wahlen Veterans Affairs Medical Center, Salt Lake City UT.
The contractor shall:
1. Provide all personnel, supervision, tools, materials, equipment, and transportation required to complete the work described in this PWS.
Remove and dispose of all equipment associated with the two GE INNOVA 4100-IQ imaging systems (Serial Numbers: 589832BU5 and 436339BU6, EEs: 57204 and 40402) in a timely fashion.

citations.quote: Work shall be performed in accordance with Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) specifications and all applicable VA, federal, state, and local requirements.

2. Perform all tasks in accordance with OEM specifications, applicable codes, VA policies, and infection control requirements.

citations.quote: Perform necessary diagnostic checks and visual inspection of both GE INNOVA 4100-IQ systems and related subcomponents to identify any issues that may impact safe removal.

text: All FSEs performing work shall be fully qualified and authorized, having formal OEM training and at least two years of field experience, with documentation provided to the COR upon request.

citations.quote: 6.1 All Field Service Engineers (FSEs) performing work under this PWS shall be fully qualified and authorized by the contractor to perform de-installation and removal of the GE INNOVA 4100-IQ systems or similar imaging systems.
6.2 “Fully qualified” FSEs shall:
Have successfully completed formal OEM or equivalent training for imaging system de-installation and related tasks; and
6.2 “Fully qualified” FSEs shall:
Have at least two (2) years of field experience with scheduled and unscheduled maintenance or de-installation of comparable imaging systems (except for equipment newly introduced to the market).
6.3 Documentation of training and qualifications shall be provided to the COR upon request.
